title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP05 — P3 generic Diff hardening in V3 and protected path configuration
goal: Bring merge-base verification, empty-diff fail-closed, protected deletion and rename detection and D20 authorization consumption into the portable V3 Diff template, move protected paths and the authorization directory into a validated Diff protection configuration loaded from the trusted base, unify the Test-V3 NuGet source per D21, and consume the CP05-auth authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: The V3 and V3_ifx Diff templates are byte-identical, contain no IFX paths, and read protected paths and the authorization directory from GUARD_PROTECTION_PATH, which Invoke-V3 sets only after validating the package protection configuration.
docs/guards/V3_ifx/stages/diff/protection.json protects the same paths as the previous hardcoded list and the manifest check requires it and the template parity.

Both Test-V3.ps1 copies are identical, restore through the V3 build baseline and cover committed, empty, protected deletion and rename, missing configuration and authorization consumption cases; the identical V3_ifx copy runs in v3-cross-platform on Linux and Windows, and the manifest check enforces template and runner parity with V3.
The pull request consumes the CP05-auth authorization: candidate verification passes and v3-pre-diff reports consumed-authorization pass, with all 13 required checks passing.
